correctness.rationale: A complete 272-matching recursion and an independent direct colouring recursion agree on all 1840 one-factorizations. Two different Kempe-neighbour algorithms agree exactly; every component/distance is computed exhaustively. Eight explicit 16-vertex graph-isomorphism witnesses, rainbow-face counts, signs, and all 384 cube automorphisms are directly checked. Sign preservation follows from a separate alternating-cycle permutation proof. Scope is finite Q4.

evidence: Asratian–Casselgren, arXiv:1403.5807, Theorem 1.3/Corollary 1.4 proves connectivity for five-edge-colourings of Class 1 quartic graphs.
McDonald–Mohar–Scheide, arXiv:1005.2248, Theorems 2-3 concern six-edge-colourings of subquartic graphs and four-edge-colourings of subcubic graphs.
Behague, arXiv:1811.06389, §3 proves a sign invariant for square switches on selected 1-factorizations.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The first two connectivity results do not assert four-colour Kempe connectivity of Q4. Behague’s sign is useful prior structure but neither class sizes nor the eight Möbius–Kantor components follow from its stated theorems.

originality.rationale: 2010 and 2014 Kempe theorems concern extra colors or other graphs; Behague gives a sign invariant for square switches but not the full Q4 four-edge-colouring Kempe graph, and 1993 rainbow work establishes existence but not connectivity. Targeted scientific and research-record searches did not reveal the nine-component partition. Earlier unindexed exhaustive calculations remain a real risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed computation or an equivalent enumeration in a graph factorization database could predate this result.
Sign was previously introduced and proved square-switch-invariant; only the specified complete class structure is offered as distinct.
The 1993 paper may inform isolated subcounts although its inspected theorem does not imply the class decomposition.

value.rationale: The graph Q4 is the canonical smallest four-regular hypercube at the sharp minimum-palette threshold where extra-colour Kempe-connectivity theorems no longer apply. Discovering the complete nine-class obstruction, its precise 128 exceptional states, eight Möbius–Kantor geometries, and exact giant-component metric supplies non-routine, naturally motivated reconfiguration information and a reproducible finite benchmark.
